Maps and location: geocoding, directions, styles, tilesets and datasets.

## API key

1. Open [console.mapbox.com](https://console.mapbox.com/account/access-tokens/) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** An access token from Access tokens in the Mapbox console, with only the scopes the app needs.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add mapbox
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  mapbox: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Mapbox's [API](https://docs.mapbox.com/api/overview/) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show mapbox` shows the key as set.

**Rate limits:** Per token and per API: Geocoding 1,000 a minute, Directions 300, Static Images 1,250; the Tokens API 100 a minute per account.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Mapbox).
